softwarePortfolioLayout.aboutApplication:
This web-based application enabled the registration of digital wills, which were then encrypted and stored in a secure digital vault for retrieval during probate. The platform managed the end-to-end process, supporting both assisted and self-managed creation of wills for financial and property assets across multiple user segments.


The system supported diverse stakeholders, including registry officials, clients, and their representatives, while an integrated mobile interface allowed users to book appointments and monitor the progress of their will. The architecture utilized APIs to securely support multiple front-end and partner portals, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality for all registered legal assets.
softwarePortfolioLayout.clientName: The Wills and Probate Registry, operating in conjunction with the DIFC Courts.
softwarePortfolioLayout.testimonialContent: The platform provided a critical, secure digital bridge for our registry process. The workflow was intuitive for our users and the encryption standards met the high security requirements of the DIFC Courts.
